name: The Henge
brief: The sun drops exactly into the Manhattan street grid and burns straight down Forty Second Street turning ten thousand silhouetted people in the roadway into one black paper cutout against molten gold, the towers glowing on both sides, eye flowers opening in every window facing west and blooming out of the sun disc itself, color story: molten sun gold and silhouette black over ink black

name: The Wallet Returned
brief: A man knocks on a Kensington door to return a wallet with everything still in it and refuses the reward twice, eye flowers opening in the doorway light, color story: doorway gold and worn leather brown over ink black

name: The Note on the Windshield
brief: A driver finds a handwritten apology and a phone number under the wiper after a scrape and stands there genuinely moved, eye flowers opening in the paper folds, color story: note paper white and car paint forest green over ink black

name: The Missing Cat Poster
brief: A hand drawn missing cat poster on a Sunnyside pole has been up for six weeks and someone has added a note saying they are still looking too, eye flowers opening in the paper tabs, color story: poster paper cream and marker black over ink black

name: The Reunion at the Shelter
brief: A dog missing for eleven days recognizes his person across an animal care center room and neither of them handles it well, eye flowers opening in the kennel bars, color story: shelter tile green and dog fur gold over ink black

name: The Catch
brief: A stranger on a Bronx sidewalk catches a toddler who slipped off a stoop rail and hands her back before the mother has finished turning around, eye flowers opening in the air between them, color story: reflex silver and stoop brick red over ink black

name: The Hands That Pulled
brief: Four riders pull a man back from the platform edge at Fourteenth Street and then all pretend it was nothing, eye flowers opening along the platform edge stripe, color story: platform stripe yellow and station tile white over ink black

name: The Compressions
brief: A nurse off duty starts compressions on a Queens platform floor while a stranger counts out loud for her and the train is held, eye flowers opening on the concrete around them, color story: platform concrete gray and emergency red over ink black

name: The Line to Give
brief: A blood drive line runs out the door of a Midtown lobby the day after bad news and nobody in it discusses why they came, eye flowers opening in the folding chairs, color story: donation bag crimson and lobby marble cream over ink black

name: The Saturday Pantry
brief: A church basement food pantry in Corona runs a Saturday line with more dignity than most restaurants and remembers every family's name, eye flowers opening in the produce crates, color story: produce green and basement fluorescent gold over ink black

name: The Coat Rack Outside
brief: A coat rack appears on a Harlem sidewalk with a sign meaning take what you need and by evening it is full again from strangers, eye flowers opening in the hanging sleeves, color story: winter coat navy and sidewalk gray over ink black

name: The Warming Bus
brief: An outreach worker convinces a man to come onto the warming bus on the coldest night of the year by simply sitting down next to him first, eye flowers opening in the bus window frost, color story: bus interior amber and frost silver over ink black

name: The Free Fridge
brief: A community fridge on a Bed Stuy sidewalk gets restocked at midnight by someone who leaves before anyone can thank them, eye flowers opening on the fridge door art, color story: fridge paint teal and midnight street blue over ink black

name: The Mutual Aid Roster
brief: Volunteers coordinate a block's deliveries off a printed spreadsheet taped to a hallway wall and cross off the final name at eleven at night, eye flowers opening in the paper grid, color story: printer paper white and hallway green over ink black

name: The Tutor at the Long Table
brief: A retired teacher tutors two kids at a branch library long table on a Tuesday and one of them finally gets the fractions, eye flowers opening in the library lamp shades, color story: library lamp green and book cloth red over ink black

name: The Study Cards
brief: A woman quizzes herself on civics flash cards on the F train with fourteen years of waiting behind her, eye flowers opening in the card stack, color story: flash card white and train seat orange over ink black

name: The Oath
brief: Two hundred people raise their right hands in a downtown federal room and one man in a brand new suit cannot get the words out, eye flowers opening in the flag folds behind them, color story: courtroom wood brown and flag red over ink black

name: The Coronation Under Chambers
brief: The young rat king Squab is crowned under a Chambers Street platform in the cashmere coat the Court tailor cut, the bent bottle cap crown lowered by an elder rat, the whole Court watching, eye flowers opening along the track bed, color story: coronation cashmere camel and tunnel gold over ink black

name: The Queen Touches the Crown
brief: The old Pigeon Queen touches her wing to the new rat king's shoulder on a girder above the tracks, ending a war nobody alive remembers starting, eye flowers opening in her wing feathers, color story: pigeon pearl gray and girder rust over ink black

name: The Old King Steps Down
brief: The retired Rat King walks alone down a disused tunnel with the juice box crown left behind on a rail, entirely at peace, eye flowers opening in the tunnel dark ahead of him, color story: tunnel black and abdicated crown gold over ink black

name: The Watcher on the Tank
brief: The Watcher sits on a Bushwick water tower catwalk at three in the morning counting the lit windows of the whole borough one by one, eye flowers opening in every window she counts, color story: watcher coat black and window light gold over ink black

name: The Watcher Comes Down
brief: After years on the roofs the Watcher climbs down into a crowded Myrtle Avenue sidewalk and lets herself be looked at for the first time, eye flowers opening around her at street level, color story: sidewalk gray and revealed face gold over ink black

name: The One Who Was Seen
brief: A man who has been invisible on the same Midtown corner for nine years is greeted by name by a stranger and has to sit down on the curb, eye flowers opening all the way up the building beside him, color story: recognition gold and corner concrete gray over ink black

name: The Second Glance Anniversary
brief: The couple from the Second Glance Wedding return to the exact subway car where they first looked twice and find someone else doing it, eye flowers opening in the car windows, color story: train car red and anniversary gold over ink black

name: The First of the Next
brief: A father carries a newborn out of a Brooklyn hospital door into New York air for the first time and cannot stop narrating the block to her, eye flowers opening in the blanket weave, color story: hospital blanket white and first daylight gold over ink black

name: The Guarantor's Ledger
brief: The Guarantor opens the ledger of everyone who owes him and starts crossing names out one by one at a Financial District desk at midnight, eye flowers opening out of the crossed lines, color story: ledger paper cream and debt ink red over ink black

name: The Landlord Who Fixed It
brief: A landlord known for ignoring everything shows up personally with a wrench on a Sunday and repairs the boiler while the tenants watch in disbelief, eye flowers opening in the boiler steam, color story: boiler room red and steam pipe silver over ink black

name: The Model Withdrawn
brief: A developer pulls the scale model of a tower off the table in front of a community board and says the words nobody expected, eye flowers opening in the tiny model windows, color story: model foam white and boardroom fluorescent green over ink black

name: The Rezoning Room
brief: A school auditorium packed past capacity where a teenager speaks last on the rezoning and the room stands up for her, eye flowers opening in the auditorium seat backs, color story: auditorium seat maroon and podium light white over ink black

name: The Garden Deed
brief: A community garden group holds the signed deed to the lot they have farmed illegally for thirty years and someone opens a bottle right there in the dirt, eye flowers opening out of the soil beds, color story: garden soil brown and tomato red over ink black

name: The Last Stabilized Apartment
brief: A woman in the same Yorkville apartment since nineteen sixty two waters her plants in a room the whole building's value is built around, eye flowers opening on every windowsill, color story: prewar plaster cream and geranium red over ink black

name: The Successor Cat
brief: A new bodega cat is placed on the counter in the old cat's exact spot and the regulars examine her with total seriousness before approving, eye flowers opening in her whiskers, color story: kitten gray and counter formica yellow over ink black

name: The Nine Lives Ledger
brief: A bodega owner shows a customer the notebook where he has recorded every stray the store has fed since nineteen eighty eight, eye flowers opening between the entries, color story: notebook cream and cat fur ginger over ink black

name: The Permit
brief: A subway musician gets the official banner at last and hangs it behind him at Times Square as if it were a knighthood, eye flowers opening in the banner cloth, color story: banner blue and station tile cream over ink black

name: The Busker's Apprentice
brief: An old saxophonist hands the instrument to a fourteen year old on a Union Square platform and steps back to let him take the crowd, eye flowers opening in the sax keys, color story: saxophone brass and platform shadow blue over ink black

name: The Old Timer's Stool
brief: A man on the same corner bar stool since nineteen seventy nine tells the newest bartender the true history of the block and she writes it down, eye flowers opening in the bar wood grain, color story: bar mahogany and beer sign neon red over ink black

name: The Stool Left Empty
brief: A bar leaves one stool empty with a full glass on the bar in front of it and nobody has to be told why, eye flowers opening in the glass, color story: whiskey amber and bar light gold over ink black

name: The Last Pour
brief: A bartender pours the final drink of a forty one year career at a Woodside pub and the whole room raises theirs at once, eye flowers opening in the pour, color story: pint gold and pub wood brown over ink black

name: The Wake at the Bar
brief: A funeral spills into a Sunnyside bar in the afternoon and by four the stories have turned everyone from crying to laughing, eye flowers opening in the raised glasses, color story: mourning black and afternoon window gold over ink black

name: The Repast in the Church Hall
brief: A church hall repast in Southeast Queens where the aunts have made too much food on purpose and a grieving son eats because they insist, eye flowers opening in the steam trays, color story: church hall beige and mac and cheese gold over ink black

name: The Chair Nobody Moved
brief: A Sunday dinner continues in a Bensonhurst dining room with one chair kept exactly where it always was, eye flowers opening on the empty seat, color story: dining room burgundy and Sunday gravy red over ink black

name: The Card in Her Handwriting
brief: A grandmother hands over a stained index card with measurements written in a language her grandson only half reads and translates it by cooking, eye flowers opening in the card stains, color story: index card cream and sauce red over ink black

name: The Coat Refitted
brief: A tailor takes in a dead man's overcoat for his daughter and gets the shoulders exactly right on the first try, eye flowers opening in the lining, color story: overcoat camel and lining paisley teal over ink black

name: The Album on the Stoop
brief: Three generations pass a photo album along a brownstone stoop and stop on the picture of the same steps in nineteen seventy one, eye flowers opening out of the old photographs, color story: photo sepia and stoop stone gray over ink black

name: The Slide Projector
brief: A slide projector throws a nineteen sixties Coney Island afternoon onto a living room wall and everyone in the room goes silent at the same frame, eye flowers opening in the projected light, color story: projector white and slide kodachrome red over ink black

name: The Tape Transferred
brief: A shop clerk plays back a transferred home video and a woman hears her mother's voice for the first time in nineteen years, eye flowers opening in the screen static, color story: video static silver and memory gold over ink black

name: The Voicemail Kept
brief: A man on a Queens bus plays a saved voicemail through one earbud and lets himself smile at it in public, eye flowers opening in the bus window reflection, color story: phone screen blue and bus window dusk over ink black

name: The Writing Behind the Wallpaper
brief: A renovation crew peels wallpaper in a Harlem brownstone and finds a hundred year old message written on the plaster, all four workers going quiet, eye flowers opening around the old handwriting, color story: plaster cream and old ink brown over ink black

name: The Marks on the Frame
brief: A door frame in a Ridgewood apartment carries pencil height marks from four different families and the newest tenant adds one instead of painting over it, eye flowers opening between the marks, color story: door frame white and pencil graphite gray over ink black

name: The Apartment Passed Down
brief: A daughter stands in the middle of the apartment she grew up in on the day it legally becomes hers and does not turn on any lights, eye flowers opening in the dark rooms, color story: dusk room blue and hallway light gold over ink black

name: The Keys in the Palm
brief: An old woman presses her building keys into her daughter's palm and closes the fingers over them without saying anything at all, eye flowers opening around their joined hands, color story: brass key gold and skin warm umber over ink black

name: The First Night Alone in It
brief: A woman sits on the floor of an empty Bushwick apartment eating takeout with the window open and hears the whole city arrive at once, eye flowers opening in the open window, color story: bare floor honey and night window blue over ink black

name: The Plate at the Door
brief: A neighbor knocks with a covered plate for someone who just moved in and refuses to come inside because the place is a mess, eye flowers opening in the steam under the foil, color story: foil silver and hallway light amber over ink black

name: The Name at Last
brief: Two neighbors who have nodded at each other for six years finally exchange names in a Washington Heights elevator and both laugh at how long it took, eye flowers opening in the elevator panel, color story: elevator brass and hallway green over ink black

name: The Conversation That Continued
brief: Two strangers keep talking on a Fort Greene sidewalk long after the elevator ride ended because neither wants to be the one who stops, eye flowers opening in the sidewalk cracks, color story: sidewalk gray and streetlamp gold over ink black

name: The Roof Introduction
brief: A new tenant climbs onto the roof and finds eleven neighbors already up there who immediately make room and hand over a drink, eye flowers opening across the tar paper, color story: tar roof charcoal and sunset tangerine over ink black

name: The Permit Granted
brief: A block association president holds up the approved street closure permit in a Bronx kitchen and four people start making calls at once, eye flowers opening in the paperwork, color story: permit paper white and kitchen tile yellow over ink black

name: The Street Closed
brief: Barricades go up at both ends of a Crown Heights block at nine in the morning and the asphalt becomes a room, eye flowers opening in the painted street lines, color story: barricade blue and asphalt gray over ink black

name: The Sprinkler and the Speaker
brief: A sprinkler cap and a stacked speaker face each other across a closed block and the first song lands exactly when the water arcs, eye flowers opening in the spray, color story: water arc silver and speaker cone black over ink black

name: The Domino Table
brief: The domino table at the block party reaches its final round and a crowd four deep watches a man slam the winning piece hard enough to hear it two blocks away, eye flowers opening on the domino faces, color story: domino ivory and folding table green over ink black

name: The Grill That Fed Everyone
brief: One man works a half drum grill for nine hours at a block party and refuses every offer of relief while quietly making sure nobody leaves hungry, eye flowers opening in the coal glow, color story: charcoal ember red and smoke gray over ink black

name: The Dance That Started It
brief: A grandmother steps into the middle of a closed street and starts the dancing herself because nobody else would go first, eye flowers opening around her feet, color story: dress floral coral and asphalt gray over ink black

name: The Photograph Everyone Is In
brief: An entire block crowds onto one stoop and the neighboring fire escape for a single photograph and the person taking it is the only one missing, eye flowers opening in every face's reflection, color story: brownstone rose and golden hour amber over ink black

name: The Cleanup at Midnight
brief: Six people sweep a closed street back to normal at midnight while the last speaker plays low and nobody is in a hurry, eye flowers opening in the swept confetti, color story: broom straw gold and midnight asphalt blue over ink black

name: The Block at Rest
brief: The barricades come down at two in the morning and the empty street holds the day's heat while one window is still lit, eye flowers opening down the whole centre line, color story: residual heat rose and night street indigo over ink black

name: The Last Look
brief: A model at the end of the final runway of the season turns at the top of the walk and holds one look for a second longer than the show called for, eye flowers opening across the entire gown and out into the front row, color story: finale white and runway light gold over ink black

name: The Mirror Faces Out
brief: An enormous mirrored panel is hoisted onto a Manhattan building face and every eye flower in the city turns to look into it at once, the reflected crowd below finding themselves looked at, eye flowers opening out of the mirror surface toward the viewer, color story: mirror silver and city spectrum over ink black
